author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Mick Abel (elbow) to make next rehab start Tuesday
desc: Mick Abel will make his next rehab appearance with Triple-A St. Paul on Tuesday.
impact: Abel has been sidelined since April 17 with right elbow inflammation but is nearing a return. He threw 47 pitches across three scoreless innings on June 10 and is scheduled to build up to 65 pitches in his next rehab outing on Tuesday. If all goes well, he is expected to be reinstated from the injured list before the end of June.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Cole Sands (forearm) shut down from throwing
desc: Cole Sands has been shut down from throwing after undergoing an MRI on Friday that revealed inflammation in the forearm.
impact: Sands was pulled from his rehab assignment in early June after his strained forearm failed to recover as expected following an outing. He will rest before resuming his throwing program and has no timetable for a return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: DL Hall (pectoral) receives anti-inflammatory injection
desc: DL Hall received an anti-inflammatory injection on Friday in his pectoral minor.
impact: Hall landed on the injured list June 5 with a left pectoral strain and recently received an anti-inflammatory injection to help reduce the inflammation. He told reporters that he spoke with Minnesota Twins pitcher Taj Bradley, who previously dealt with a similar injury, which gave him confidence that his recovery timeline would be four to eight weeks.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Cole Ragans (elbow) to undergo MRI Monday
desc: Cole Ragans is scheduled to undergo an MRI on Monday.
impact: Ragans landed on the injured list on May 8 with left elbow impingement. He had progressed in his throwing program and completed a 23-pitch bullpen session on Wednesday, but woke up with discomfort on Friday, which ultimately forced him to cut his next throwing session short. He is scheduled to undergo an MRI to determine the severity of the setback.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Emilio Pagan (hamstring) to throw simulated game Tuesday
desc: Emilio Pagan is scheduled to throw a simulated game on Tuesday.
impact: Pagan underwent an MRI on June 13 that cleared him to face hitters. He threw a bullpen session on Friday and will now advance to facing hitters. If all goes well, he could begin a minor league rehab assignment shortly thereafter.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cal Raleigh (oblique) expected to be activated Tuesday
desc: The Mariners expect to activate Cal Raleigh from the injured list on Tuesday.
impact: Raleigh concluded his rehab assignment over the weekend. He should be back behind the plate for Tuesday's series opener against the Orioles.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Emerson Hancock roughed up Sunday
desc: Emerson Hancock allowed six runs on nine hits over four innings with two strikeouts in a loss on Sunday against the Nationals.
impact: Hancock was lit up for five runs in the fourth inning alone. He still carries a strong 3.28 ERA on the season and will look to bounce back against the Red Sox.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Rodolfo Duran goes deep Sunday
desc: Rodolfo Duran went 2-for-4 with a home run and three RBI in the Padres 5-2 win over the Orioles on Sunday.
impact: Duran hit his second long ball in as many days. He also added an RBI double for a three RBI afternoon.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mason Miller logs four-out save Sunday
desc: Mason Miller recorded a four-out save on Sunday against the Orioles.
impact: Miller struck out three for his 19th save on the season. It was his first save chance since June 6.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Walker Buehler earns win Sunday
desc: Walker Buehler allowed one run on six hits over five innings with five strikeouts in a win on Sunday against the Orioles.
impact: Buehler was able to avoid giving up any free passes, lowering his ERA to 4.14 on the season. He'll face the Rangers next.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cristian Javier (shoulder) has rehab start postponed Sunday
desc: Cristian Javier had his rehab start for Triple-A Sugar Land rained out Sunday.
impact: Javier had been scheduled to make his third rehab outing. He'll likely get pushed back to the next few days.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Wade Meckler suffers head injury Sunday
desc: Wade Meckler left Sunday's game against the Rays with a head injury.
impact: Meckler is considered day-to-day heading into Monday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Andrew Fischer promoted to Double-A
desc: The Brewers are promoting infield prospect Andrew Fischer to Double-A Biloxi.
impact: Fischer was the Brewers' first-round pick out of Tennessee last year. He hit .298 with 20 home runs with High-A Wisconsin.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Orlando Arcia designated for assignment
desc: The Twins designated INF Orlando Arcia for assignment.
impact: Arcia loses his spot on the Twins 40-man roster. He will head to waivers as a result where he could draw some interest.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyler Fedko has contract selected by Twins
desc: The Twins selected the contract of OF Kyler Fedko from Triple-A St. Paul.
impact: Fedko will be making his MLB debut. It is unclear what role he will be stepping into in the majors.
